text:
Maya: FYI — NimbusPay renewal flagged by CS tooling. Usage down ~75% week-over-week, appears right after their SSO rollout. Need quick triage.
Rohit: On it. Is the drop across the org or one service?
Maya: Narrowed to `invoices` microservice. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/orgs/nimbuspay/usage (screenshot sent).
Liza: I pinged their eng lead — reply: "We've been seeing 500s on token exchange since Friday, invoice ingestion stopped."
deploy-bot: upload: s3://redwood-logs/nimbuspay/ssologs/2026-03-20.tar.gz
Ethan: Quick log grep shows `oauth: invalid_grant - redirect_uri_mismatch` during token exchange. They changed callback path.
Rohit: That would break the nightly batch they run against `POST /v1/generate-token`. I'll pull traces and error rates.
Ana: Sales flags: procurement heard competitor demo that called us out for SSO friction. Renewal in 3 weeks — high risk if we don't move fast.
Maya: Proposed immediate plan: 1) Ethan patch redirect mapping asap (ETA 3h). 2) Rohit standby with API-key rollback instructions for them (ETA 1.5h). 3) I'll schedule a 30m warroom with NimbusPay + send comms offering hands-on migration help + a temporary dedicated slot if needed. 4) Ana to prep commercial concession thresholds.
Ethan: Created staging patch to accept both `/auth/callback` and `/auth/sso/callback`. Tests pass locally.
Rohit: Tracing shows error spike starting 2026-03-19 22:10 UTC, matching their deploy. Preparing hotfix rollout.
deploy-bot: incident CS-2026-045 created, priority=high, assignees=[Ethan,Rohit,Maya]
Liza: NimbusEng: "Thanks — we'll be on the sync at 10:30 PT. Can you enable a fallback API-key while we fix our config?"
Maya: We'll offer fallback and a hands-on session. If usage recovers to >90% baseline within 12h, no commercial concession. If not, escalate to procurement playbook and ready the 30-day dedicated offer. :crossed_fingers:
Ethan: Hotfix rolled to prod, monitoring 2xx rate.
Rohit: Seeing gradual recovery — invoices requests at ~60% of baseline after 45m. Continuing to watch.
Maya: Great. I'll capture notes in renewal tracker and loop AMs/AE for procurement readiness.
Ana: Preparing draft concession approval in case we need to fast-track.
Maya: Thanks team — keep updates coming in this thread.
